newsitem.title: PERU: Peru floods kill three, destroy hundreds of homes.
newsitem.headline: Peru floods kill three, destroy hundreds of homes.

text.p: Three people died and hundreds of families lost their homes in flooding in Peruvian mountain and jungle districts in the past 24 hours, civil defence officials said on Tuesday.

In the jungle province of San Martin, where a week of torrential rains has swollen rivers, floodwaters destroyed the homes of 500 families and swept away a woman and two children in the village of Yuracyacu.
In the Andean district of Abancay, where five people died in flooding on Sunday, another flash flood destroyed the village of Pumaranra on Tuesday but all 40 families were saved.
"All the houses have disappeared but we evacuated the people in time," said local civil defence official Homero Nurena.
Flash floods, known locally as "huaycos", are common in the Peruvian Andes during the rainy season from January to March.
